title: Asymptotic Behavior of the Principal Eigenvalue Problems with Large Divergence-Free Drifts
summary: In this paper, we consider the following principal eigenvalue problem with a large divergence-free drift: \begin{equation}\label{0.1} -\varepsilonΔφ-2α\nabla m(x)\cdot\nabla φ+V(x)φ=λ_αφ \,\ \text{in}\, \ H_0^1(Ω),\tag{0.1} \end{equation} where the domain $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^N (N\ge 1)$ is bounded with smooth boundary $\partialΩ$, the constants $\varepsilon>0$ and $α>0$ are the diffusion and drift coefficients, respectively, and $m(x)\in C^{2}(\barΩ)$, $V (x)\in C^γ(\barΩ)~(0<γ<1)$ are given functions.
